name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for window seal repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for window seal repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for window seal repair in the Bay Area, look for companies with strong local reputations and experience specific to insulated glass unit replacement. Check for proper licensing and insurance for general contractors. Read customer reviews and ask for references. Ensure they provide clear, written estimates and warranties for their work and materials. A reputable contractor will also perform an on-site assessment to accurately diagnose the problem and recommend the best solution for your windows in cities like San Bruno or South San Francisco.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with local experience, proper licensing and insurance, good reviews, and clear estimates and warranties for their window seal repair services.
